headline: Exchange Inflows Fell To 346.8 Million Dollars As Bitstamp Took In 433.8 Million
narrative: Exchanges took in 346.8 million dollars across assets over 24 hours, 0.1277 percent of custodied value excluding each venue's own token, down from 1,087.6 million dollars and 0.4005 percent. The figure is the change in dollars held on trading venues, so a positive print means that money arrived where holders can sell, and the smaller print means that arrival slowed. Bitstamp took in 433.8 million dollars and Binance took in 129.7 million, while Bitfinex shed 232.6 million and Bybit shed 100.5 million.
author: jordan
